covered.rule: Variables: title plus last name; now drives all date rules
1. digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, call is recorded
1. Do not say collections, debt, payment or the product before verification; applies to relatives
2. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
3. confirmation words; ask once more; unclear -> not_reached/unclear
4. robot/AI question
5. third party: say nothing beyond opening, ask when reachable
6. callback today or next business day 10:00-19:00, after now -> not_reached/callback
7. ask once for another time, else not_reached/no_callback
8. wrong number
9. deceased: 'I am sorry for your loss.'
10. relative may not answer security questions or be told anything
11. DOB then phone last 4; YYYY-MM-DD; numbers read as day-month-year
12. three wrong answers in total
13. hint day_month_swapped -> ask month as a word, not counted
14. failed -> mobile app or branch, not_verified/failed
15. explain once, decline -> not_verified/declined; asking purpose counts
16-17. get_account; collections team about a late payment; product naming
18. band table early 1-7 / 12th business day / 1; late 8-45 / 7th business day / 2
19. promise date today or later, business day, not after deadline
20. weekend/holiday -> next business day
21. vague period: ask once, then propose deadline
22. next <weekday> = following calendar week
23. after deadline -> offer deadline; refusal = flat refusal
24. full first, never ask how much
25. floor minimum_payment / instalment_amount
26. floor once, the rest stays overdue
27. accept floor..full; below floor offer floor once
28. Can you make this payment today?
29-31. persuasion attempts; attempt 1 last business day this week/next; attempt 2 floor on deadline; no_promise/refused
32. hardship: sympathy, offer support transfer, else no_promise/hardship; before 30 and 41; may still record
33. never offer discount/waiver/plan
34. read back and 'Do you confirm?'
35. changes at confirmation re-checked
36. one promise per product; change in mobile app
37. retry once, then no_promise/service_error
38. You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
39. already paid -> paid
40. dispute -> no_promise/dispute
41. restructuring transfer
42. human: ask once, then general transfer
43. scam question
44. cannot answer
45. refuse to talk twice (after / before verification)
46. outcome table; transfer after promise -> transferred
Brief A never uses add_note
47. thank and say goodbye before close_call
1 (The job). one product

fixed: identity.source: added rule 3's full text (accepted confirmation words; answering a customer question first) and rule 15's 'second refusal closes the call', because neither could be traced anywhere in the JSON.

bands[late].source: added rules 29, 30 and 31 (a proposed date or amount is never a refusal; flat refusal uses one attempt; do not repeat a refused offer; close no_promise/refused). These rules constrain the attempts but were not quoted.
third_party.callback.source: added rule 5 (say nothing beyond the opening; ask when the customer can be reached).
amounts.source: added 'The agent proposes every amount', the rule-26 floor refusal = flat refusal, and the rule-27 below-floor handling.
promise_write.source: added rule 35 (re-check a changed value and read it back again) and rule 36 (one promise per product).
phrases.source: added 'This applies to everyone, including relatives' for prohibited_before_verification.
unresolved: added rule 33 (never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or other term). No schema field holds it.
unresolved: added hardship precedence over rule 41 (restructuring). before_persuasion only covers rule 30.

Verified with no change needed: all values are present in the brief or the API, every enum value (close_call outcomes, transfer queues, verify_identity fields, product types, the hint and wrong_answers_left properties) exists in tools/openapi.json, there is only one source document so no precedence conflicts arise, and the file contains no nulls.
unresolved: Opening sentence is described, not dictated verbatim (rule 1).

debt_intro, robot_reply, scam_reply, already_paid_sentence, cannot_answer_sentence and recorded_promise_change_reply give content only, with no exact wording. No customer service phone number is given for the scam reply.
Hardship sympathy sentence is not dictated (rule 32).
How to resolve a date said without month/year is not specified.
No multi-product today question (one product only).
Rule 33 prohibition of discounts/waivers/plans has no schema field.
Hardship precedence over restructuring (rule 41) has no schema field.
